results.evidence: Menu labels are clear (Today, Practice, Review, Colleges, More; More sheet groups Study/Planning/Community/Account, R-W070-more-sheet-390-{night,day}.png); no 'Go to Home' vs 'Arena' pair exists (marketing says 'Go to Practice'). results.evidence: Dock is a blur(32px) saturate(1.5) glass capsule with sliding spring lens; real mouse-down on Review gave transform matrix(0.96) in Night and Day (R-W071-press-review-390-*.png); More sheet and Start sheet are glass with spring. Measured live: lens moves by column index (translate 222 px at More). Glass is limited to dock/sheets, not applied everywhere. Desktop hover capture was inconclusive (page mid-transition), so hover on sidebar rows is not independently proven.

Core app pages (Today, Review, Result, Practice, Start sheet, Progress) have strong type, lamp-lit objects, Mobi scenes and motion. Not premium everywhere: public features/about/privacy are text-only lists with no imagery (R-pub-features-390-night.png), Your standing and Help are sparse, Rival is a dense dark card grid, Ask Mobi is a box inside box.
results.fix: Bring features/about/standing/rival up to the Today/Result standard (one hero object, fewer boxes) before claiming a premium pass.

results.evidence: Live (not stills): clicking dock Practice from Today gave a fade-through at 50/120/200/300 ms with staged entrance of the Mode block and the lens sliding (R-W073-trans-sheet-new.png); ViewTransition is wired (placeTransition.js, startViewTransition called). results.fix: Add admission-compass to PLACE_ORDER in dock order; confirm count-up duration on a device.

results.evidence: By design the phone Start key stays lime on every page, so at 390 any page with its own lime primary shows two lime fills: Practice (Start 10 questions + key), Today (Start Revise), Review (Open Accountancy), Colleges (View courses), Your standing, Result, Your Mob, Ask Mobi (three: selected chip too), Rival, Recovery. results.fix: Either make the 390 key outlined whenever the page owns a lime primary (data-page-primary, same as desktop) or get the owner's explicit waiver of one-volt for the dock; add data-page-primary to Account, Ask Mobi, Rival, Recovery.
